lines: Carl Jung said the people who feel lost are closest to becoming unstoppable.
See, the hardest realization from working at corporate job was that the person I'd spent years trying to become no longer felt like me.
And it scared me because it meant that I was a failure.
I had this idea that if you don't get it right the first time, you're just automatically behind.
And it's because we live in a culture obsessed with certainty.
We idolize people with 10 year plans and polished identities while uncertainty is seen as a weakness.
But in reality, before every single meaningful transformation comes a period of feeling lost and frustrated.
Most people just assume growth feels good, but it doesn't.
It feels like a loss of control over your identity.
But it's where any meaningful change is found.
It allowed me to pursue my dream life and embracing it was the best thing I ever did.

spine.big_idea: Feeling lost is not failure, it is what real change feels like before it arrives.
spine.before: I'm lost, so I'm failing and falling behind
spine.after: Feeling lost means I'm probably about to change
spine.viewer: People who feel lost or stuck in a career or identity
spine.format: quote hook → fear admitted → cultural belief → flip: growth feels like loss → what embracing it gave me
spine.hook_promise: Feeling lost is a good sign, and you'll hear why.
why: The Jung quote flips what lost means before any story starts
The fear is told in plain words, so the viewer feels seen
Blaming culture lets the viewer drop the shame before the flip lands

points.summary: Real change is always preceded by feeling lost and out of control
Feeling lost makes people believe they have failed and fallen behind
points.proof: the author's fear at the corporate job (lines 2-3)

points.summary: Our culture rewards certainty, so uncertainty looks like weakness
points.proof: people with 10 year plans and polished identities (line 6)

points.summary: Embracing the lost period is where meaningful change is found

why do we think being lost means failing?
so what is actually true then?
so what did it get you?

card.name: Lost before change
card.use_when: I felt stuck or lost, and the feeling turned out to be the start of a change.
card.needs: a real story with a clear low point. Missing → don't use this card.

beats.name: Why

The hook quote can be swapped for a personal claim.

said: Jung says people who feel lost are close to becoming unstoppable
Becoming the person I planned no longer felt like me, and it scared me
Our culture worships certainty, so being unsure feels like failing
Before any real change comes a lost, frustrated stretch, and growth feels like losing control
Embracing the lost period let me pursue my dream life
